written: 2026-11-15, before any Phase 6 rule was implemented or run
principle: Three genuinely different market hypotheses, each a research question, not an assumption that it works. Simple baselines first; at most three pre-declared refinements per hypothesis; frozen before sealed validation; rejection accepted.

hypotheses.title: Volatility regime decides the behaviour
hypotheses.question: Do different market conditions require different strategy behaviours?
hypotheses.hypothesis: Trend continuation works when M15 volatility is expanding and fails when it is contracting; a liquidity-sweep reversal behaves the opposite way. The sign of each behaviour's expectancy depends on the regime (an interaction), not just its size.
hypotheses.mechanism: Expanding volatility reflects directional order flow that tends to carry breaks further; in contracting, range-bound conditions breaks are more often liquidity grabs that revert.
hypotheses.entry: VOL-C: H1 structure in the trade direction and a fresh M15 break of structure (BOS) in that direction within 2 candles. VOL-F: a sweep of liquidity (equal highs/lows, previous-day or session levels) on M15 within 3 candles, confirmed by an M5 change of character (CHoCH) in the reversal direction within 3 candles. Both: spread at most 0.50.
hypotheses.exit: VOL-C: stop beyond the unbroken M15 swing (0.1 ATR buffer), target 2R, at most 240 minutes. VOL-F: stop beyond the unbroken M5 swing (0.1 ATR buffer), target 1.5R, at most 120 minutes.
hypotheses.invalidation: The stop, i.e. price returning beyond the swing that defined the setup.

prediction.text: Expectancy of VOL-C in expanding > in contracting, AND expectancy of VOL-F in contracting > in expanding; the favoured cells (VOL-C expanding, VOL-F contracting) are each positive after costs with at least 20 trades.

allowed_refinements: filter: volatility_regime on M15 (the hypothesis itself)

hypotheses.title: A higher-timeframe change of character adds information
hypotheses.question: Can structural changes provide useful information beyond the existing entry conditions?
hypotheses.hypothesis: An H1 change of character (CHoCH) starts a new directional leg. M15 continuation entries in the new direction during the first 12 H1 candles after it do better than the same M15 entries when H1 merely trends (the condition the earlier strategies used).
hypotheses.mechanism: A fresh higher-timeframe structural shift marks a change in who controls price; entries early in a new leg have more room than entries late in a mature trend.
hypotheses.entry: STR-X: an H1 CHoCH in the trade direction within the last 12 H1 candles and a fresh M15 BOS in the same direction within 2 candles. STR-0 (control): identical, except that the H1 condition is only 'H1 structure in the trade direction'. Both: spread at most 0.50.
hypotheses.exit: Stop beyond the unbroken M15 swing (0.1 ATR buffer), target 2R, at most 480 minutes, and exit when H1 structure flips against the trade.
hypotheses.invalidation: H1 structure flipping back against the trade (the structural change failed), or the stop.

prediction.text: Expectancy of STR-X > expectancy of STR-0, and STR-X is positive after costs with at least 60 trades.

hypotheses.title: Session breaks behave differently and persistently
hypotheses.question: Are there repeatable differences between trading sessions that persist across months?
hypotheses.hypothesis: A confirmed M15 break of a session high or low that happens around the London open (Asian/London overlap or London) tends to keep going for several hours, while the same breaks during the Asian session tend to fail. The difference persists month after month.
hypotheses.mechanism: London opens with the largest change in participation; breaks of the overnight range then carry new information, whereas Asian-session breaks happen in thin trading.
hypotheses.entry: SES-B: a confirmed M15 break of a session high (long) or low (short) within the last 2 M15 candles; spread at most 0.50. No session filter, so every trade is labelled with the session it occurred in.
hypotheses.exit: Stop beyond the unbroken M15 swing (0.1 ATR buffer), no fixed target, at most 360 minutes (the break is given time to run into New York).
hypotheses.invalidation: The stop: price returning beyond the swing that preceded the break.

prediction.text: London-open trades are positive after costs with at least 60 trades, better than Asian-session trades, and positive in at least 60 % of the development months that have at least 5 such trades.

STR-X.name: Phase 6 STR-X: M15 continuation after an H1 CHoCH (baseline)

STR-0.name: Phase 6 STR-0: M15 continuation with H1 trend only (control)

development.data: January to 13 November 2026 only (already examined in Phases 5.2/5.3, so using it for debugging costs no independence)
development.refinements: At most 3 per hypothesis, each one of the allowed kinds, each built by the tool from a parent configuration (no free-form edits) and each preceded by a written rationale that cites the development evidence. Every trial is recorded and counted in the final report.
development.gate: A hypothesis may be frozen for sealed validation only if its prediction holds on the development data. Otherwise it is recorded as not supported at development, and the sealed data is not spent on it.

sealed_validation.data: Vantage MT5 XAUUSD M5, M15 and H1, November 2023 to October 2025 (24 calendar months), exported once and imported into its own research-store series. No Phase 6 code may read it until a hypothesis version is frozen.
sealed_validation.forward: Data recorded from the market open after 13 November 2026 onward is the final forward confirmation; it is never used for development.
criteria: data: at least 18 of the 24 months have sufficient data (95 % coverage and warm-up); other months are INCOMPLETE and excluded
expectancy: pooled expectancy after costs > 0 R per trade
trade_count: at least 100 pooled trades (a minimum screen, not proof)
profit_factor: pooled profit factor at least 1.1
consistency: positive in at least 60 % of valid months, positive in each 12-month half (Nov 2023-Oct 2024 and Nov 2024-Oct 2025), and positive without its best month
prediction: the hypothesis's own prediction (regime, context or session difference) also holds on the sealed data
execution: still positive with spread and slippage doubled (tripled is reported only)
timeframes: run on M5 and on M15 execution; M15 positive as well
sealed_validation.classes: promising (every criterion passes), inconclusive (positive but at least one criterion fails), rejected (pooled expectancy <= 0). Classes describe historical research candidates, not trading readiness.
sealed_validation.after: Only a promising candidate may move to read-only paper-monitor observation on forward data; Phase 4 is never changed.
